summary: Nobody loses access by accident, and owners see each month what will be extended.

new.title: Monthly list of upcoming extensions
new.text: Department owners get a monthly list of permissions about to be extended, and can Approve or Deny on My people. No answer means extended.

fixes.title: Nobody loses access by accident
fixes.text: Permissions with an empty auto-extend setting were not extended. They now follow a default that is on; FALSE still means never.

fixes.title: Extended 14 days before ending
fixes.text: Extension now happens 14 days before the end instead of 30, adjustable from 1 to 90 days.

fixes.title: Access reviews decide extensions
fixes.text: A person kept in their department's review is extended; one removed in the review is not.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: Auto-extend is now a picker in the grid: TRUE, FALSE or empty for the default.
